title: Implement bounded operating-context self-optimisation

intent.outcome: Close #2641 through #2647 in three stacked PRs that make independent routing and closeout compact, make review/validation writes recoverable and identity-safe, and prove bounded source-owned adaptation with real-session evaluation.
non_goals: Do not add a second workflow, proof cache, PR tracker, event store, optimiser, or learned override layer.
Do not weaken active-owner overlap protection, proof admission, authority, or closeout claim boundaries to reduce cost.
Do not retain raw prompts, full transcripts, or provider-specific review state as checked-in operating context.

parent.contribution: Deliver the concrete routing, lifecycle, validation, adaptation, and evaluation slices required for bounded self-optimisation.
parent.closure_boundary: The three-PR stack may close #2641-#2647 only after integrated proof and a current evaluation conclusion; each lower PR claims only its owned issue slice.

owned: src/agentic_workspace/workspace_runtime_planning.py, workspace_runtime_startup.py, workspace_runtime_core.py, reporting_support.py, review_stack_transitions.py, and review_stack_topology.py
Validation manifest publication/reconciliation and proof selection/reuse owners under src/, packages/verification/, scripts/, and their focused tests
Existing improvement/reconciliation and Evaluation owners, compact observation/report artifacts, docs, release changes, and focused scenario tests
effects: Independent tasks receive a stable non-interference contract and compact closeout answers avoid optional recursive hydration.
Review lifecycle writes fail closed unless current topology identity is admitted; validation manifests self-heal and proof reuse follows causal dependencies.
Recurring material friction converges into deduplicated source-owner adaptation candidates and real-session evaluation proves later-task benefit.

refs: Focused pytest per stack layer, routed implement/proof selection, package checks where owning contracts change, and integrated stack proof

next_action: Publish the first stacked PR for #2641 #2642 #2643, then implement #2644 #2645 on its exact head.

claims: Independent task routing is stable, bounded, and non-interfering while real owner overlap still fails closed.
Review lifecycle and validation manifest mutation are identity-safe, transactional, and self-healing.
Proof follow-through is delta-shaped and source-owned adaptation converges across at least two owner classes.
A current Evaluation result covers representative real sessions and one later equivalent-task convergence sequence.
requirements: Run focused runtime and review-stack tests for #2641-#2643 plus compact output byte/hydration assertions.
Run validation manifest and proof selection/reuse tests for #2644-#2645 including interruption and release replay fixtures.
Run improvement/adaptation and Evaluation lifecycle tests for #2646-#2647, then routed integrated stack proof and repository checks.
refs: Default closeout_trust measured at 15,150 answer bytes before the final compact projection update

continuation.residual_intent: Do not close the parent until all three stack layers, integrated proof, and the real-session evaluation conclusion are present.
